# Prolewatch 0.12.3

`0.12.3` is an experimental patch release for x86-64 Arch Linux. Independent
auditing remains outstanding. Start evaluation on an isolated system.

- The package now includes `prolewatch(1)` and `prolewatch-config(5)` manual
  pages. The AUR metadata also tells users to run `prolewatch setup` after
  installation.
- The AUR recipe downloads `prolewatch-0.12.3.tar.gz` and its detached
  signature from this release. It verifies the archive checksum and pins the
  maintainer fingerprint through `validpgpkeys`.
- The public key is attached as `prolewatch-release-key.asc`. Its fingerprint
  is `296E983E7120909958BD38E557F1F87148E02B27` and it is also available from
  public keyservers.

The Linux amd64 binaries, SBOMs and binary archive are verification artifacts.
The supported installation path is the
[`prolewatch`](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/prolewatch) AUR package.
